purpose: Prospective paired ablation of canonical input freshness after E004 development results were inspected
historical_lag_status: Unverified historical initial publication; used for fitting only, never historical profit claims
forward_inputs: Exactly the raw index and market snapshot archived for the original E004 forecast; no later refresh or pending source values
comparison: All four fresh-input variants versus all four original frozen variants and the same raw market midpoint; intersect eligible contracts within event
primary_metric: Event-averaged Brier score; each UTC day is one dependent cluster across horizons and strikes
secondary_metric: Log loss with probability clipping at 1e-6
selection: All variants retained; no tuning, model selection, confidence claim or promotion from the two-hour initial engineering run
historical_validation_scores: Do not evaluate the new model on the already examined September 1-5 E004 validation days
